title: omxqua: tokens, then components, then every page
subtitle: Three files and a skill; one root class repaints everything

nodes.label: tokens.css
nodes.desc: Colours, radii, one soft shadow scale and Liquid's spring curves. Dev, travel, kids and money; every pair clears 4.5:1.
nodes.notes: 51 checks pass: contrast in every family and skin, CSP.

nodes.label: fonts.css
nodes.desc: Self-hosted fonts, so nothing loads from a third party.

nodes.label: components.css
nodes.desc: Islands, cards, buttons, sheets, dialogs: opaque tonal surfaces from Google, nothing glassy.

nodes.label: omxqua.js
nodes.desc: Every tap squashes and springs back, from Apple. The more often a thing happens, the less it moves.

nodes.label: The skill
nodes.desc: Makes an agent read the reference, pick a family, use the real parts and check the page at phone width.

nodes.label: Your agent
nodes.desc: Ask for a screen in words; the skill makes it build from omxqua's parts.

nodes.label: omxlabs.tech
nodes.desc: This site is drawn in omxqua: every product in its own colour, on the same tokens.

nodes.label: omxcode site
nodes.desc: omxcode's cover and docs use the same tokens, fonts and parts.

nodes.label: Your app, phone
nodes.desc: Any web app: four links and one line of classes. Designed at 390 wide first, with 44 px targets.

nodes.label: omxcode apps
nodes.desc: Native omxcode apps on the same tokens is on the roadmap as an idea; it isn't built.

steps.note: oq-family-money on the root: the tokens swap to Ledger's accent and mono amounts.
Every part reads the same variables, so nothing else changes.
So does any app on the same files, at phone width too.
The skill makes it read the reference and pick a family.
It builds from the real parts, not lookalikes.
Then it checks the page at 390 wide.
